description: Transit Oriented Communities is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. This dataset provides a spatial representation of Transit‑Oriented Community (TOC) sites across the City of Toronto. The map identifies publicly owned lands located near existing or planned rapid transit stations that are being considered or advanced for higher‑density, mixed‑use development. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are development. It offers 16 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, SHP. The portal shows 2026-05-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
